## WFHTracker Visual Design

For all UI, styling, layout, component, and UX changes, read and follow:

`/docs/WFHTRACKER_STYLE_GUIDE.md`

The style guide is the authoritative source for the WFHTracker visual design.

When modifying the UI:

- Reuse existing components and visual patterns where possible.
- Reuse the existing Tailwind theme, colours, spacing and typography.
- Do not introduce new colours, fonts, button styles, icon styles or visual patterns without a clear requirement.
- Preserve the established WFHTracker visual identity.
- Consider desktop, tablet and mobile layouts.
- Keep the interface simple, calm, clear and consistent.
- Do not redesign unrelated parts of the application when implementing a specific request.
- Prefer simple, maintainable solutions over unnecessary abstraction or visual complexity.
